After interchanging the signs, we get:

4 is not divisible by 8, so we cannot get 40 as the final value.

3 X 12 ÷ 18 - 2 + 20 = 35

LHS = 3 X 2/3 - 2 +20

=20. So LHS≠ RHS.

64 - 8 X 12 ÷ 10 + 7 =32

12 is not divisible by 10 and hence cannot give final value as 32.

24 + 84 ÷ 12 - 5 X 3 =16

LHS= 24+7-5 X 3

=24+7-15

=16=RHS. Hence this equation is correct.

questions.q_en: Few kids are sitting, forming a semicircle. If Lena is sitting on 4th position from left end and Rachel is sitting on 20th position from left and 3rd position from right end, then how many kids are sitting between them?
questions.solution_en:
We can understand the given question by the figure below:

Lena is sitting 4th from left side i.e. 3 more kids are sitting before Lena from left

Similarly, Rachel is sitting 3rd from right side i.e. 2 more kids are sitting before Rachel from right and she is also sitting on 20th position from left side i.e. 19 kids are sitting before Rachel from left.

Total number of kids sitting between Lena and Rachel = 19-4 = 15

By the Position: Total number of kids sitting between Lena and Rachel = Position of Rachel from left - Position of Lena from left -1

=20-4-1=15

questions.q_en:
61 is related to 18 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 213 is related to 38. To which of the following is 509 related, following the same logic?

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 - Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting / multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution_en:
We have the relation as:-

61 is related to 18, and

213 is related to 38,

The pattern it follows is:-

For (61,18)

43 - 3= 61 , 42 + 2=18

Similarly for :- (213,38)

63 -3= 213, 62+ 2= 38

Following same pattern for :- 509, we get:-

83 - 3= 509 and 82 + 2= 66

Option (a) is the correct answer.

questions.q_en:
In a certain code language,

'A * B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A ^ B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A < B' means 'A is the son of B'

'A > B' means 'A is the sister of B'

'A @ B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A ~ B' means 'A is the brother of B'

Which of the following coded chains means X is the nephew of Y?
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) X @ D < E ^ Y

X @ D → X is wife of D

D < E → D is son of E => E is parent-in-law of X

E ^ Y → E is father of Y => Y is child of E

=> X is sister-in-law of Y.

Option (b) X ~ F > G < Y

X ~ F → X is brother of F

F > G → F is sister of G => G is sibling of F

G < Y → G is son of Y => Y is parent of G

=> X is son of Y.

Option (c) X < A ~ B > C ~ Y

X < A → X is son of A

A ~ B → A is brother of B => B is sibling of A

B > C → B is sister of C => C is sibling of A

C ~ Y → C is brother of Y => Y is sibling of C

=> X is nephew of Y.

Option (d) X ^ H @ I ~ Y

X ^ H → X is father of H

H @ I → H is wife of I => I is husband of H

I ~ Y → I is brother of Y => Y is sibling of I

=> X is father-in-law of the brother of Y.
